system.description:
Rangers who walk the old green paths and learned the druids' quiet magic along the way.

  • Thorn Snare (1st): once per encounter, when you hit a creature in natural terrain, roots and briars grip it: it makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or its speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.
  • Warden's Lore (1st): Advantage on checks to identify plants, animals and natural omens.
  • Nature Magic (5th): cast divine Nature spells from the Druid list, up to 4th level, using the Paladin Spells Per Day table.
  • Wisdom is your casting attribute, and your spell DC is 10 + half your Ranger level (minimum 1) + your Wisdom modifier.
  • You prepare spells each morning from the Druid list, as a Druid does.
  • Warden's Communion (10th): once per day, cast one Druid spell you have prepared, of 2nd level or lower, without expending a slot.
